items.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: Milt Gabler and Sy Oliver, who was his musical director... They employed me as a secretary

ctx.x: Would he sit with the pianist perhaps and learn the tune that way? © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-

No. No. All you had to do was play it for Louis. No in fact you know when I first met Louis I worked at Decca Records. I know poor Jackie’s heard the story ten times. But the first day I was there Milt Gabler and Sy Oliver, who was his musical director and Milt Gabler was the A&R man, who incidentally is Billy Crystal’s uncle, darling man, wonderful, I loved him. They employed me as a secretary, sharpen pencils, file, you know all kind of that really coolie jobs. But they gave me the music and told me to bring it…
How did he decide what was going to be recorded?
